name: scrb — AI Product Descriptions for WooCommerce
author: vøiddo

sections.description:
scrb generates professional product descriptions, SEO-optimized titles, meta descriptions, bullet points, and social media copy directly inside the WooCommerce product editor. Built for sellers with 50+ products who don’t have time to write each one by hand.

One click on a product → full description, SEO title, 5 bullet points in 25+ languages.

What it does

  • One-click description generation from inside any WooCommerce product
  • SEO titles + meta descriptions auto-filled into Yoast SEO and RankMath
  • Amazon-style 5 bullet points
  • 25+ languages, written natively (not translated)
  • Tone control: professional, casual, luxury, fun, technical, minimalist
  • Platform-optimized output: Amazon, Etsy, Shopify, eBay, or general WooCommerce
  • “Improve description” mode — rewrite an existing description with AI
  • Free tier with no credit card required

Why scrb is different

  • No external service subscription needed — your scrb account covers everything
  • No copy-paste between tools — runs natively in WooCommerce product editor
  • Free tier with no card required
  • 25+ languages from a single product input
  • Yoast + RankMath integration shipped from day one

Free tier

Free tier available, no credit card required. Just install, click generate, paste output.

Paid plans

Paid tiers unlock higher monthly limits, batch CSV import on the higher tier, and API access on the top tier. Current pricing and tier limits are at https://scrb.voiddo.com/pricing — kept off this page so it stays accurate as plans evolve.

External services

This plugin connects to the scrb AI service operated by vøiddo (https://voiddo.com)
at the host scrb.voiddo.com. Connecting to this service is required for the
plugin to function — without it, no AI content can be generated.

What the service is and what it is used for:
* The scrb AI service generates product descriptions, SEO titles, meta
descriptions, bullet points and tags from the product data you provide.
* It also returns your account’s plan, monthly usage counter, credit
balance and (if enrolled) affiliate referral totals so the plugin can
display them in Settings and on the product edit screen.

What data is sent and when:

  1. On the product edit screen, when you click “Generate” or “Improve”:
    POST https://scrb.voiddo.com/api/v1/generate (or /generate/improve).
    Request body contains: product name, taxonomy terms (categories), the
    first 15 product attributes, the selected platform, tone, language and
    target description length. For “Improve” the existing product
    description (HTML stripped) is also sent.

  2. On the Settings page, when you click “Verify”:
    GET https://scrb.voiddo.com/api/v1/auth/me. Sends your API key in the
    X-API-Key header so the service can return the matching account
    email and plan.

  3. When the Settings page or the product metabox is opened (only after
    you have entered an API key):
    GET https://scrb.voiddo.com/api/v1/billing/usage,
    GET https://scrb.voiddo.com/api/v1/credits/me and
    GET https://scrb.voiddo.com/api/v1/affiliate/me. These send only your
    API key in the X-API-Key header to read your own account state.

Every request also includes a User-Agent of scrb-wordpress/<plugin
version> and an X-Scrb-Client: wordpress_plugin header so the service
can identify the plugin version. No request is made before you save an
API key, and no request is made on the public-facing site — all calls
originate from wp-admin.

This service is provided by vøiddo:
* Terms of service: https://scrb.voiddo.com/terms
* Privacy policy: https://scrb.voiddo.com/privacy

vøiddo does not train AI models on the data you submit through the
plugin, and the data is not used for any purpose other than fulfilling
the request you initiated.

About

Built by vøiddo — a small studio shipping AI-flavoured products, free dev tools, Chrome extensions and weird browser games.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the scrb-ai folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via Plugins → Add New → Upload
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Go to Settings → scrb AI
  4. Enter your API key (get one free at https://scrb.voiddo.com/app/settings)
  5. Edit any WooCommerce product and use the “scrb AI” panel in the sidebar
sections.faq:
Do I need a scrb account?

Yes. A free account is enough to try the plugin end-to-end. Paid tiers unlock higher monthly limits — see https://scrb.voiddo.com/pricing for current plans.

Does this work without WooCommerce?

The product-editor integration is WooCommerce-specific. The plugin will activate on any WordPress site, but the per-product “scrb AI” panel only appears on WooCommerce product edit pages.

How is this different from generic AI writing tools?

scrb is purpose-built for product descriptions and runs inside the WooCommerce editor. Generic AI writing tools require copy-pasting back and forth. scrb writes once, applies once, no friction.

Do I need any other AI service key?

No. scrb uses its own AI engine. You only need a free scrb account.

How fast is generation?

3-5 seconds per product description on average.

Can I bulk-generate descriptions?

Pro tier and above support batch CSV import. Upload a CSV of products, the plugin generates descriptions for each, you export with descriptions filled in.

Where does my data go?

Product names + features go to scrb.voiddo.com → AI engine → returns generated text. Nothing is stored after generation. We don’t share or sell your data. Privacy policy: https://scrb.voiddo.com/privacy

What languages are supported?

English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Arabic, Hebrew, Chinese (Simplified + Traditional), Japanese, Korean, Turkish, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Hindi, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Czech.

Does it work with Yoast SEO or RankMath?

Yes. The “Apply SEO title” button writes to both Yoast (_yoast_wpseo_title) and RankMath (rank_math_title) meta fields automatically.

Is the free tier really free?

Yes. No credit card, no trial expiration. See https://scrb.voiddo.com/pricing for the current free-tier limit.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes — managed via Paddle (our payment processor) self-service portal. No questions asked.

What happens when I hit my monthly limit?

You’ll see an error from the API. Upgrade your plan at scrb.voiddo.com/app/billing.
